title: Speedrun WR (6:50) Kuldra RAID w/ Commentary RS Dragonwilds
author: TexasPete.21

commentary.text: Missed me. All right, let's see what we got right here. Let's go. Big jump. Oh.
All right, here's the moment of truth. Where all runs go to die. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh.
All right, this is super sketchy right here. We got to risk it. This is a good run.
I'm not risking this right here. This run's too good to mess up right here.
Last little piece right here. I'm going to risk it all. Going for the big jumps.
Okay, clean. Clean. I'm going to spam this. Spam. Spam.

textNotes.text: This is the first ever sub 7 run for version Patch 1.0.0.6+

Recorded on 10/14/26 this is prior to the windstep double jump and some other new routing strats. Shoutout to @iNanobit for pushing the limits of this run. By no means a perfect run but great execution and got some good RNG on my jumps here.

textNotes.author: @808oh8
textNotes.text: The whole skip is patched now correct?

textNotes.author: @Keimbho
textNotes.text: @808oh8 Yes the whole skip is cooked. Also if you do the raid how it should be it's impossible to finish it as the guardian about 1/4 of the boss fight will tele  you to a phantom platform that will make you fall and die. No one will be able to finish the boss whether they do it legit or cheese it.

textNotes.author: @EvoTheWizard
textNotes.text: Absolutely one of the cleanest runs I've seen and i watch kuldra speedruns alot , also nice catkeep skip very smooth indeed ,might just have to sub to see how you deal with new patches,  love it great vid 👍

textNotes.author: @rygokenzyrchu4497
textNotes.text: Brother, great vid. How are you launching yourself like that

textNotes.author: @texaspete.2173
textNotes.text: Surge off the edge of stuff. Sometimes it works better than others.

textNotes.author: @Jacob_White
textNotes.text: So with the new patch out does this run become null and void?

textNotes.author: @tristenbolt9965
textNotes.text: Half these skips not available on console 😢

textNotes.author: @lordjunk5847
textNotes.text: I’m on Xbox and everything I saw I’m able to do on console other than the last way to get the last extraction point since on console there’s a wall there. But there’s an alternative route. Fastest I ever did on console was 11 minutes.

textNotes.author: @kodyxd
textNotes.text: ​@lordjunk5847  all the dash skips he showed in the video are patched so unless you can somehow play pre patch, what you just said is untrue

textNotes.author: @IINo1goodII
textNotes.text: ​ @kodyxd this lol. I found every single one and still play on the pre patch version anyways

I believe this is the first ever sub 7 run if I'm not mistaken
